about: Proofs retired on purpose because their feature was removed (#947). scripts/loosen-prove.mjs lets a PR delete a scripts/ or server/ *-prove.mjs only when that exact path is already listed here on main, before the deleting PR. Only the repo owner may change this file: loosen-prove fails any change to it unless the PR's author and the account that started the run are both the owner (the one exception: anyone may create it with no entries where main has none, since an empty list lets no proof go). A rename away from *-prove.mjs still fails, and a listed proof that is edited rather than deleted is still checked for loosening.
schema: Each entry: { "file": "scripts/name-prove.mjs", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "issue": 123, "reason": "why the feature and its proof are gone" }
